0.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_000_000
0.description: I issue wares as rewards to those who contribute to the reconstruction effort. My apologies, but I am afraid I cannot accept gil.

1.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_000
1.description: Welcome, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>! You honor us with not only your presence, but your contribution besides!

2.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_010
2.description: Now, you may have heard that contributing to the cause earns you skybuilders' scrips. These may be brought here to be exchanged for a selection of wares.

3.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_020
3.description: In order to attract ever more contributors, we endeavor to expand the range of items offered.

4.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_021
4.description: We endeavor to expand the range of items offered, that we might continue to attract contributors, even now that the reconstruction effort itself has been completed.

5.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_030
5.description: Aside from donating items, you may also earn scrips by participating in concerted works. Have you been informed about these, perchance?

6.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_040
6.description: In which case, I urge you to have the details from Chief Foreman Augebert. Meanwhile, I shall look forward to exchanging many scrips for you!

7.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_050
7.description: Aside from donating items, you may also earn scrips by bringing materials gathered in the Diadem. Have you been informed about these, perchance?

8.name: TEXT_CTSHWDCURRENCYSHOP_00650_ENIE_010_060
8.description: If not, Flotpassant will be able to furnish you with the particulars. Meanwhile, I shall look forward to exchanging many scrips for you!
